"""Call unchanged native inspect with all exact inputs, without shell ARG_MAX truncation."""

import argparse
import runpy
from pathlib import Path

from common import ROOT, read, relative


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument("--input-list", required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--targets", required=True, type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    paths = read(args.input_list)
    assert isinstance(paths, list) and len(paths) == len(set(paths))
    argv = [
        "--repo-root",
        str(ROOT),
        "--schema",
        str(ROOT / "schema/record_review.yaml"),
        "inspect",
        "--targets",
        str(args.targets),
    ]
    for p in paths:
        argv += ["--input", relative(p)]
    native = runpy.run_path(
        str(ROOT / "scripts/record_review.py"), run_name="lyxose_native_review_inspection"
    )
    return native["main"](argv)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
